name: W4 · Gully heads and corridor edge (draft) – north gully
notes:
Job: where the western side gullies start and the vine-forest corridor edge begins. Zone 5, left wild.
Weed control only (molasses grass, lantana and other woody weeds), working in from the edges a little at a time.
Let local species come back; if gaps need help, plant only local LFW rainforest species.
No fruit trees, no earthworks, no burning; leave fallen timber in the gully.
Placed at the heads of LiDAR flow lines (2022, 1 m), where water first gathers into a channel.
Draft from the 19–20 Oct western high edge plan – adjust on site.
